v: Casting + makeup మాత్రం terrific... movie మాత్రం political spoof collection la anipinchindi 😐 RGV says audience wants entertainment. Naaku ikkada adhe miss ayyindi.
e: Amma Rajyam Lo Kadapa Biddalu felt less like a movie and more like a long political spoof designed to ridicule a few people while glorifying another. The uncanny casting, makeup and imitations are genuinely impressive, but beyond that I found almost no story, emotion or entertainment to hold onto.
body:
I generally watch a movie as a movie and nothing else…..but still its was crystal clear that RGV made this movie with the sole intention of making mockery of few ppl and project one person as the greatest leader…..

i liked Lakshmi’s NTR as irrespective of whom it targetted it showed the love of between an aged and lonely old man & an already married women and the consequences they faced as the oldman belong to one of the powerful political family.

but in this movie there is nothing but just a mockery of ppl and audience by just showing spoof’s.

The only positive/good I see in the movie is the terrific work done by the casting directors and make up artists to closely match the real life chars and nearly perfect imitation of Lokesh, Pawan Kalyan and KA Paul.

As RGV himself says in the movie that “In Politics or Cinemas or in life the audience doesnt expect anything other than entertainment” and this film is far and miles away from providing any sort of entertainment to the general audience!!!

v: Title laga this is Venky Mama’s show 😄 His comedy + emotion + mama-alludu chemistry save whatever they can... climax varaku మాత్రం patience test full ga.
e: Venky Mama survives almost entirely on Venkatesh’s effortless comedy and emotional timing and the chemistry between the uncle and nephew. The story, dialogue, direction, music and BGM leave little impression, while the pre-climax and climax become so illogical that even Venky’s charm cannot fully save the film.
body:
as the title suggests….its Venky’s one man show!!! apart from Venky’s Comedy & Emotional Timing along with Mama-Alludu chemistry there is nothing much to say about the story, dialogues, direction, BGM or Music. The pre climax and Climax episodes test the patience of audience with complete illogical sequences _/\_

only Venky Mama is the saving grace for this otherwise below par film…….

v: LOVED IT!!!!!! 😂 Logic, emotion, message anni intlo vadilesi vellandi. Akshay full madness... only my Aakhri Pasta deserved much better 😄
e: Housefull 4 knows exactly what kind of movie it wants to be: loud, illogical and proudly ridiculous. It is neither the best nor the worst of the franchise, but Akshay Kumar’s expressions, the ensemble madness and a stream of absurd surprises made it a thoroughly enjoyable time-pass watch for me.
body:
LOVED IT!!!!!! a perfect movie for you…if u want to enjoy a fun filled crazy movie without any logic!!!! but if u are a person who expects logic emotions and mesaage then please be at home….

I have been following all the Golmal and Housefull series and though this is not the best but it is not the worst……

Akshay Kumar is the real allrounder of Bollywood where he can fit into the super Action/National Integrity/Message Oriented and now into the madness of the Housefull so effortlessly and man he steals the show with his epic facial expressions and it really takes a lot to accept a char which is just a main comedian role and not a hero of the movie!!!!!

Being a big fan of Aakhri Pasta I was dissapointed that this char was not etched properly unlike the previous housefull series…..barring that dissapointment one can expect a lot many mad suprises like Nawazuddin doing an ITEM SONG and The Hulk Rana playing kawaalli singer Rangeela Raja _/\_

overall a nice time pass and laugh riot movie if you dont mind the illogical plot and mad comedy!!!!!

v: First 45 mins almost punishment 😪 But revolt start ayyaka movie totally changes gear. Chiru’s eyes + dialogue diction + final stretch make it a proper big-screen ride 🙏
e: Sye Raa starts with a very familiar patriotic-film template and spends too long on family and romance, but the movie changes dramatically once its central conflict takes over. From there, Chiranjeevi, the huge supporting cast and the technical departments combine to deliver the scale, intensity and fan moments the opening stretch was missing.
body:
To start with….the film simply follows the tested format and screenplay of a Patriotic Movie with Char Introduction and Initial days, Followed by the Opression and then Revolt followed by Backstabbing and The End!!!!! and to make matters worse the first 45 mins of the movie was a pain with focus more on Narasimha’s family, romance etc…..and simply Chiru -Nayantara, Tammana combination was not convincing!!!!!

but what followed after the first painful 45 mins makes this movie a Block Buster……once the main conflict has been established it was a treat to watch all the efforts put in by the Director, Fight Masters, Dialogue Writters, DOP and Music Directors _/\_

with the actors like Chiru, Amitabh, Kicha Sudeep, Jagapathi Babu, Ravi Kisan have ensured to carry the intensity of the movie on their shoulders……though he put all the best efforts its bit hard to Imagine Chiru who is of 60+ years of age in the char of a warrior, but the Intensity in his EYES and the diction of his dialogues were simply awesome and convince us to ignore his age!!!! Acting wise its his best performace after Apadhbandhavudu!!!!!

Direction by Surrender Reddy has been very good and he ensured to give those awesome moments for the Chiru fans….special mention of the final 10 mins which showed the brilliance of Chiru’s Intensity to the core _/\_

Finally Tammana and Kicha Sudeep got meatier roles after being ignored in Bahuballi…..Tammana did a very good job and Kicha Sudeep has simply excelled himself where he totally owned up the scenes and even dominated Chiru with his careless attitude…..dissapointed that Vijay Sethupathi was limited to only couple of scenes and didnt had much scope to showcase his talent but adds value with his screen presence!!!! Amitabh’s char was far more subtle as a guru…..but when all these wonderful actors fill up the screen its an Awesome view!!!!!

Finally…..All the Technicians and Actors have worked really hard to make Chiru’s dream project a SUCCESS!!!!!!
